description: This file defines acceptance tests for the Activities module in a SuiteCRM project, specifically testing the display of the due date in the activities subpanel during a user workflow involving account and call records.

classes.name: ActivitiesCest
classes.description: A test class for acceptance testing of the Activities module, involving setup and verification of subpanel views and related record manipulations.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method to initialize fake data generator and seed value before each test.

methods.name: testSeeDueDateSubpanelView
methods.description: Test method verifying the visibility of the due date on the activities subpanel for an account, including workflows for account and call creation, related record verification, and cleanup.
